Results Of all scenarios evaluated, many resulted in similar consequences, yielding a total of 79 unique outcomes, shown in Appendix A along with associated process parts, operation states, guidewords, and severity values. These consequence outcomes were evaluated for severity and placed in categories based on low, medium, and high risk. The analysis resulted in one scenario in the high risk category, 43 in the medium risk category, and 35 in the low risk category. This illustrates that there are few high risk scenarios related to hydrogen rail in maintenance facilities and that the vast majority of activities are low or medium risk.
